name: Rahiluddin Rohila
summary:
Dynamic and results-driven professional with a proven track record in sales
and business development. Expertise in driving online B2B and B2C sales,
establishing strategic partnerships, and exceeding sales targets. Strong
leadership and team management skills, with a focus on delivering exceptional
client service. Adept at tracking and reporting sales performance, while
maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction. Committed to achieving
excellence and recognized for outstanding achievements in driving revenue
growth.
